## Functions

### func Abs

```go
func Abs(f float64) float64
```

Abs returns the magnitude of f, clearing its sign bit, including for zero.

### func Copysign

```go
func Copysign(x float64, y float64) float64
```

Copysign returns the magnitude of x with the sign bit of y.

### func Float32bits

```go
func Float32bits(f float32) uint32
```

Float32bits returns the IEEE 754 binary representation of f, with the sign bit of f and the result in the same bit position.

### func Float32frombits

```go
func Float32frombits(b uint32) float32
```

Float32frombits returns the floating-point number corresponding to b, with the sign bit of b and the result in the same bit position.

### func Float64bits

```go
func Float64bits(f float64) uint64
```

Float64bits returns the IEEE 754 binary representation of f, with the sign bit of f and the result in the same bit position.

### func Float64frombits

```go
func Float64frombits(b uint64) float64
```

Float64frombits returns the floating-point number corresponding to b, with the sign bit of b and the result in the same bit position.

### func Inf

```go
func Inf(sign int) float64
```

Inf returns positive infinity for sign >= 0 and negative infinity otherwise.

### func IsInf

```go
func IsInf(f float64, sign int) bool
```

IsInf reports whether f is infinite with the requested sign; zero accepts either sign.

### func IsNaN

```go
func IsNaN(f float64) bool
```

IsNaN reports whether f is a not-a-number value.

### func Ldexp

```go
func Ldexp(frac float64, exp int) float64
```

Ldexp returns frac multiplied by 2\*\*exp, preserving signed zero and non-finite values.

### func NaN

```go
func NaN() float64
```

NaN returns an IEEE not-a-number value.

### func Signbit

```go
func Signbit(f float64) bool
```

Signbit reports the sign bit, including for zero and NaN.
